summary: Ezekiel laments for Israel because she has been taken captive by other nations and has become like a vine planted in dry and thirsty ground.
meta_description: Ezekiel laments for Israel because she has been taken captive by other nations and has become like a vine planted in dry and thirsty ground.

footnotes.note2_a: Reference is to Judah, of which the royal house came. (Recall Gen. 49:8–12.)
